current_and_future_real_estate_projects.description: The current Burundi market trend is off-plan properties. Investors prefer to purchase off-plan properties in Burundi and new homes instead of developing a ready-made rental portfolio. JMNI-GROUP Properties offer an impeccable array of off-plan properties in Burundi. Backed by the latest information, these project developments are launched by Burundi’s most trusted developers. Off-plan properties in Burundi play a major role in strengthening this sector in Burundi off-plan. Burundi’s growing economy and profitable returns on off-plan property investment make it an ideal choice for those looking to invest in the real estate sector. With numerous new off-plan projects being announced almost every month, JIMNI-GROUP Properties is here to assist you to identify the smart investment opportunities available in Burundi off-plan.
